svg.title: What is inside the harness_evals package
svg.desc: C4 component view. Your evaluation script imports the public API in __init__.py; a terminal or CI runs cli.py. runner.py calls your adapters and writes runs/<name>/episodes.jsonl and manifest.json, which cli.py reads. report.py imports compare.py; compare.py imports metrics.py and usecase.py; runner.py imports usecase.py; usecase.py imports metrics.py; metrics.py and usecase.py import core.py. calibrate.py imports nothing.
svg.text: Nine small modules. Your script talks to the public API; the CLI reads saved runs.
